test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
‘P + Q’ means ‘P is the wife of Q’

‘P – Q’ means ‘P is the daughter of Q’

‘P × Q’ means ‘P is the father of Q’

‘P ÷ Q’ means ‘P is the brother of Q’

If ‘V + M ÷ R – K’, how is R related to V?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Wife
 Daughter
 Father
 Brother
 
 

 

Given: V + M ÷ R – K

It means: V is wife of M, M is brother of R, R is daughter of K.

 

So, R is the '**Husband’s sister'** of V. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c26b796a294569541ee41686576b342748d687cb1b5e69e80376100ecae85a3.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
